Q2 FY27 RESULTS CONFERENCE CALL 
Results Announcement for the Second Quarter ended September 30, 2026 
Hyderabad (India), October 9, 2026: Cyient (Estd: 1991, NSE: CYIENT) is a global 
lifecycle engineering company powering mission-critical industries from design to 
aftermarket, across products, plants, and networks. We partner with over 300 global 
customers across 30+ countries, supported by more than 15,000 associates. Recognized 
among the Top 10 pure-play global engineering services providers, we reported $658M 
in annual revenue for FY26. Across Aerospace, Rail, Automotive and Mobility, 
Connectivity, Utilities, Mining, Energy, Healthcare and Life Sciences, and Spatial 
Intelligence, we combine deep domain expertise, human insight, and AI to deliver 
intelligent engineering solutions. To learn more, visit https://www.cyient.com/ 
We will be announcing our results for the Second Quarter on Thursday, October 22, 
2026. Following the release, our senior management team comprised of Krishna 
Bodanapu - Managing Director & Executive Vice-Chairman; Sukamal Banerjee – 
Executive Director & CEO; and Shrinivas Kulkarni - CFO will conduct an earnings 
conference call. The earnings call will start at 05:00 PM IST (07:30 AM New York, 12:30 
PM London and 07:30 PM Hong Kong and Singapore time) for 60 minutes. 
Please use the link below to join the call 
https://zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_2gRW6dDuREyf6VOnAukKPA
